### Problem

Every callers run, the hourly drift check included, opens pull requests in these repositories that fail and wait for a person, so the org-sync lane never finishes on its own.

### Scope

`scripts/sync-repos.py` (the callers run: which callers a repository gets, which repositories it skips, the trailers of its commits), its `--test`, and its doc header.

### Out of scope

Setting up the battery in the repositories that cannot run it yet. The release caller (#671).

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given a repository of kind wordpress-plugin with no main plugin file, readme.txt or composer.json, when the callers run computes what it wants, then plugin-checks-wp.yml is not in it and the run says why.
C2: Given a repository listed under `no-workflows` in repos.yml, when the callers run goes over the organisation, then it opens no issue or pull request there.
C3: Given any callers branch the run writes, when its commits are read, then each carries `AI-assisted: yes` and `Assisted-by:`, and passes dilux-agentic-workflow's check_commits.

### Criticality

Normal
